description: Compare renewing in place with moving over one horizon: NPV and discounted effective rent of each case (rent schedule with free rent, TI net of allowance, fees, moving, downtime, double rent, termination, and disruption costs), the starting rent at which they break even, and year-by-year cash flows. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.renew_vs_relocate@2 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

current_rent_monthly.description: Total monthly rent under the existing lease, USD per month for the whole premises (not $/SF). Prices the double-rent overlap in the relocate case.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.08, applied to both cases (monthly rate = annual ÷ 12).

horizon_months.description: Analysis horizon in months; both cases run for this term (e.g. 120 for a ten-year renewal versus a ten-year new lease).

buildout_cost.description: Total cost to build out the new premises, USD, before any allowance.

disruption_cost.description: Explicit one-time cost of business disruption beyond rent and downtime (lost customers, staff turnover), USD.

downtime_cost_monthly.description: Cost of a month of downtime (lost margin, temporary space), USD per month. Multiplied by downtime_months.

downtime_months.description: Months the business runs at reduced capacity around the move.

moving_cost.description: Moving, IT, cabling, signage, and stationery costs, USD.

overlap_months.description: Months of double rent: the old premises are still paid (at current_rent_monthly) after the new lease starts.

schedule.description: New-premises rent terms: commencement date, area, starting $/SF/yr, escalation, and abated (free) months. The term is horizon_months.

abated_months.description: Fully abated (free) months, 1-based from commencement (e.g. [1,2,3] for three months free up front). Each listed month's base rent is zero.

area_sf.description: Rentable square feet, or the quantity leased in unit (kW, MW, units, acres, keys, rooms, spaces) when unit is set.

commencement_date.description: Rent commencement date, YYYY-MM-DD. Month n starts on this day-of-month (clamped to month end).

escalation.description: How base rent escalates. Omit for flat rent.

oneOf.description: Flat rent for the whole term.

every_months.description: Months between bumps (12 = annual). The first bump takes effect in month every_months + 1.

rate.description: Bump as a decimal, e.g. 0.03 for 3%. Bumps compound.

oneOf.description: Fixed $/SF bumps: rate_k = starting_rate + amount × k.

amount.description: Dollars per SF per year (or per unit per year when unit is set) added at each bump, e.g. 0.50.

every_months.description: Months between bumps (12 = annual). The first bump takes effect in month every_months + 1.

round_rate_to_cents.description: Round each step's $/SF/yr to cents, as many lease rent tables do.

starting_rent_psf_annual.description: Year-one base rent in dollars per SF per year (annual, not monthly), e.g. 42.5; per unit per year when unit is set (a $/kW/month quote × 12).

termination_cost.description: Early termination fee, holdover premium, or restoration obligation at the old premises, USD.

ti_allowance.description: Landlord TI allowance at the new premises, USD. Offsets buildout_cost; any excess is not paid out.

renew.description: Stay and renew the existing lease.

renewal_fee.description: Fees to renew (legal, brokerage paid by tenant), USD.
